P.expected_type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)) (h_H001 : E.Nonempty) (h_H002 : IsCompact E), dimH (GDProduct E) = dimH E + 1

correspondence.explanation: The parameters are every n:ℕ (all nonnegative integers) and every set E of the Euclidean n-space GDVec n. H001 is precisely nonemptiness and H002 precisely compactness; no further project assumption is added. GDProduct E consists exactly of points (x1,…,xn,t) with x∈E and 0≤t≤1, in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin(n+1)). Its prescribed Euclidean metric is the inherited L2 metric, with the product distance identity checked by T009. Native dimH has exactly D004's nonnegative extended-real critical-exponent definition; T001/T002 connect its measure to the given unnormalized covers. Thus the terminal equality is the whole required dim_H(E×[0,1])=dim_H(E)+1, including n=0, under exactly the original hypotheses.
